_about: Which funding projects count as textile projects, and the keywords they are tagged with.
Read by the network page (site/network/index.html) and db/mysql/import_funding.py: change it here only.
Each keyword is a case-insensitive regular expression (the same syntax in JavaScript and Python),
matched on whole words, with the Dutch terms folded into the English keyword.
Core terms name the textile, clothing, leather or footwear sector itself; related terms
(fibre, fabric, dye, wearable, ...) are common outside it and never make a project relevant on their own.
A project is relevant when, after the idiom is removed:
1. a core term is in its title (or in its CORDIS keywords), or
2. core terms occur at least twice in its summary, counted in one language (NWO repeats it in Dutch and English), or
3. a core term occurs once and a related term also occurs.
